description: International Airlines - Traffic by city pairs is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics (BITRE). Scheduled operations of international airlines to and from Australia. Data on passengers, freight and mail carried between city pairs connected by single flight number services. Monthly data. Coverage is Australia with international comparisons, 1985 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: CSV (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and network flow and freight or traffic assignment models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
